name: @tundraconnect/deribit
description: Typed Deribit API client for Deno, Bun, Node.js, browsers and Cloudflare Workers: option-chain discovery, book summaries and historical trades over REST, plus a JSON-RPC WebSocket feed of trades, order books with change_id gap detection, tickers with mark IV and greeks, DVOL, price indices and option mark prices.
